summary: StudentTrainingPrograms is a user control and data layer module that manages the assignment, tracking, and workflow of student training program records. It supports CRUD operations (create, read, update, inactivate/reactivate) for training program entries associated with students. The system enforces workflow-driven form submissions, validations, and conditional rendering based on editability.
purpose: To allow users (typically staff) to manage student training programs — add, update, inactivate/reactivate entries; search entries by student or ID; display program data in editable/read-only forms; and ensure data quality through validations.

entities.name: StudentTrainingProgram
entities.description: A record linking a student to a training program, includes program, stage, agency, dates, comments, activity status.

entities.name: StudentTrainingPrograms
entities.description: Collection manager for StudentTrainingProgram objects; provides search, add, update, inactivate logic.

workflows.name: Add Student Training Program
steps: User initiates Add operation via gridData/cmdAdd.
FormView uxDetail changes to Insert mode.
User fills required fields (program, stage, agency, dates, comments).
Validations are triggered (e.g. required fields, date format).
Upon valid input, ObjectDataSource dsDetail calls Add method with parameters.
DB procedure StudentDetailsTrainingProgramAdd executes.
Redirect and cache session.

workflows.name: Edit Student Training Program
steps: User initiates Edit operation via gridData/cmdEdit with selected row ID.
FormView uxDetail changes to Edit mode.
Fields populated from DB via dsDetail.SelectParameters.
User updates fields.
Validations are triggered.
Upon valid input, ObjectDataSource dsDetail calls Update method.
DB procedure StudentDetailsTrainingProgramUpdate executes.
Redirect and cache session.

workflows.name: Inactivate/Reactivate Program Entry
steps: User triggers cmdDelete or cmdReactivate in gridData.
inactivateRow method calls DataLayer.StudentTrainingPrograms.Inactivate with ID and inactivate flag.
DB procedure StudentDetailsTrainingProgramInactivate executes.
Redirect and cache session.

workflows.name: Search Student Training Programs
steps: Search invoked (by studentID or ID) using DataLayer.StudentTrainingPrograms.Search or SearchID methods.
Stored procedures StudentDetailsTrainingProgramSearch or StudentDetailsTrainingProgramSearchID execute.
Results returned as StudentTrainingProgram objects with formatted fields.

business_rules: Only users with edit permission can add/edit/inactivate/reactivate program entries.
Inactive flag controls visibility and UI action buttons (edit/delete/reactivate).
Program dropdown is populated by department and agency context.
Stage/agency dropdown values depend on entry context.
validations: Comments field has max length 1000, enforced via UI JavaScript.
Date fields are validated and formatted (StartDateFormatted, EndDateFormatted).
Required fields (program, stage, agency, dates) must be filled; cancel on invalid.
UI disables edit fields if screen is not editable.
Dropdowns select current values on edit.
calculations: Date fields are formatted for display.
conditions: FormView mode determines field binding, dropdown population, and command names.
ScreenIsEditable controls visibility of edit/save buttons and editability.
system_behavior: gridData setup processes add/edit/delete/reactivate buttons per row based on Inactive status and ScreenIsEditable.
After insert/update/inactivate/reactivate, system redirects and caches session.
Dropdowns populated dynamically based on department/agency or entry being edited.
dependencies: HSPnetSession (context for user and DB access)
DateFormatter for date parsing and formatting
Stored procedures: StudentDetailsTrainingProgramSearch, StudentDetailsTrainingProgramAdd, StudentDetailsTrainingProgramUpdate, StudentDetailsTrainingProgramInactivate
exceptions: Insert/update cancelled if Page.IsValid is false.
DB access cancelled if UserSession is null.
Null/empty comments disables relevant UI elements.
content_gaps: UI layout, page navigation, and screen-level permission logic not fully described.
No explicit error handling documented for DB failures or invalid dropdown values.
No description of what triggers ScreenIsEditable or ReadOnly.
